chunks: 4542 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, the fragrance of Paradise is perceived from a distance of five hundred years, yet neither one undutiful to his parents nor a dayyuth will perceive it."
It was said: "O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, what is a dayyuth?"
He said: "The one whose wife commits adultery while he knows of it."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, whose fragrance is described as reaching an immense distance
key_terms.دَيُّوثٌ: A man who lacks protective jealousy over his wife’s sexual misconduct
key_terms.رِيحُهَا: Its fragrance, referring to the scent of Paradise
key_terms.عَاقٌّ: A person undutiful or disobedient toward his parents

ai.seo_question: Who is described as a dayyuth in this hadith, and what punishment is mentioned for him?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that grave moral corruption can deprive a person of even the fragrance of Paradise, despite its vast reach. It specifically condemns undutifulness to parents and the absence of protective jealousy regarding one’s spouse. The report underscores the seriousness of family ethics and moral responsibility.
